detailed_description:
Angular stylised 3D animation, brush-stroke texture, Surrey, 1894, violet lightning from the west, black shadows.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. The shot opens on a wide view of a hundred-foot Martian fighting-machine, a brass cowled hood on one long leg reaching forward and two long legs reaching back like a camera tripod pursuing four or five little black figures across the green-grey meadow, with Kew Lodge at the far RIGHT frame edge and the carrier behind the machine. The camera is At chest height on the road verge, seventy feet from the meadow, a 35mm lens, violet twilight from the left. At the first frame tHE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the Martian fighting-machine, a great metallic body with jointed legs and a carrier behind it; four or five little black figures run ahead across the middle; Kew Lodge stands beyond at the far RIGHT frame edge; meadow grass fills the lower frame; the violet sky fills the upper edge. The camera pushes in toward the Martian fighting-machine for ten feet across the whole shot as the four or five figures run across the field, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the machine's carrier sways behind its body, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:08 the camera is pushing in through the last frame, with the machine reaches the center meadow; the little black figures spread across the field; the carrier projects behind the body; Kew Lodge is now in frame, and the action continues with it.
